relations.support_notes:
BUDA
The colophon names the author as: dge slong spong ba pa dkon mchog gsum gyis 'bangs (*Triratnadāsa)

comments:
According to the colophon, notes (zin bris) based on the sayings (gsung sgros) of the monk brTson 'grus seng ge that were composed as a memorandum (brjed byang) on an instruction (man ngag) pertaining to the meaning of the 28 verses of the base text and on the author's own understanding.

The author addresses the view of other unidentified scholars.

This work appears first (volume ka) in a collection of the author's works. For the second work (volume kha), see (ID:5394), for the third (volume ga) (ID:5398), for the fourth (volume ca) (ID:5400), for the fifth (volume cha) (ID: 5402), for the sixth (volume ja) (ID: 5404). Five more volume appeared in [KUYBGM7V], vol. 105.
